parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds all other parts such as doors, drawers, and base in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support panel of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden hinged panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden hinged panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the left side of the cabinet’s internal storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right drawer is a sliding storage compartment located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to store smaller items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Drawer (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left drawer is a sliding storage compartment located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to store smaller items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.
